quest.1E9B91AB1CD4463E.quest_desc: Building this reactor is fairly simple, but we’ll need plenty of resources to construct it.
Let's start by building a 5x5x5 reactor.
{image:catalyst:textures/quest_images/oritech/reactor_1.png width:200 height:100 align:center}
{@pagebreak}
First, we'll place a single, double, or quad fuel rod to shape the reactor's interior.
At least one fuel rod of any type is required to form the multiblock.
It doesn't matter where you place them, just make sure to leave space for the cooling blocks!
{image:catalyst:textures/quest_images/oritech/fuel_rod_1.png width:200 height:100 align:center}
{image:catalyst:textures/quest_images/oritech/fuel_rods_2.png width:200 height:100 align:center}
{@pagebreak}
Next, we'll place Heat Absorbers directly adjacent to the fuel rods to cool them down.
{image:catalyst:textures/quest_images/oritech/heat_absorbers.png width:200 height:100 align:center}
{@pagebreak}
Now, we’ll install heat pipes to distribute the heat, preventing a meltdown alongside the Heat Absorbers or Heat Vents.
If the reactor is wider, heat vents are required to dissipate all the excess heat!
Additionally, place a Neutron Reflector at the center of the fuel rods to increase efficiency and boost energy production.
{image:catalyst:textures/quest_images/oritech/layer_1.png width:150 height:100 align:center}
{@pagebreak}

Once all of this is set up, we’ll continue adding layers. However, we must place Fuel Rod Ports directly above the fuel rods and a Coolant Absorber Port to introduce Coolant (Ice Blocks, in this case).
{image:catalyst:textures/quest_images/oritech/neutron_and_rods.png width:200 height:100 align:center}
{@pagebreak}
At the top of the multiblock, additional reactor walls are not required—you can leave it open without causing any issues.
However, if you prefer a cleaner look, you can seal it off for aesthetic purposes.
Finally, we need to place an Energy Port and a Controller anywhere on the reactor’s walls to complete the multiblock structure.
{image:catalyst:textures/quest_images/oritech/full_reactor.png width:100 height:100 align:center}
{@pagebreak}
If everything was built correctly, we now have a fully functional nuclear reactor!
{image:catalyst:textures/quest_images/oritech/reactor_controller_build.png width:200 height:100 align:center}
quest.1E9B91AB1CD4463E.title: &lBuilding Our Reactor
quest.20B90CB484A3AE7B.quest_desc: The Synergy Matrix addon is a must!
It increases both speed by 1/3, but you need less efficiency addons

Once all cores are in place, press &l&eRMB&r again on the Assembler Controller to complete the multiblock!
quest.22530C57215BC0AB.quest_subtitle: Avengers Assem... nevermind, this joke is not good
quest.22530C57215BC0AB.title: &lThe Assembler
quest.22BE285408BF2C14.quest_desc: Now, this might sound strange, but this mod introduces quality levels inside our machines.
The higher the quality, the more addons you can install. The &ePrimitive&r Core, being the lowest tier, can’t handle too many addons.
Now, I know 14 doesn’t sound that low, but once you understand this system, you’ll be able to craft &bBasic&r and &3Advanced&r Cores to make your machines faster and more efficient.
The best part? You can craft both the 3 first tiers of Cores without needing tons of setup, just materials found while mining and some micro craftings

quest.2707AD39B9821F55.quest_desc: The Spawner Controller is yet another method available to spawn any type of creature we want to farm.
To use it, simply craft it, place it, and let the desired mob &3walk over&r the spawner. After that, we’re ready to start our mob farm!

Depending on the type of creature, we need to create a cage made of Spawner Cages (&6this cage varies depending on the mob; for example, an Enderman requires a taller cage, not a wider one&r). The Spawner Controller will &bhighlight&r an area suitable for that specific mob. Keep in mind that the Spawner Controller must be placed before setting up the cage.
Once everything is correctly set up, the cage will display the mob's soul inside it.
To activate it, we need to feed the Spawner Controller with &9Souls&r. Once enough souls have been provided, it will start spawning the mob with no issues!
quest.2707AD39B9821F55.title: &lSpawner Controller

quest.2AF4E2ACA37140A7.quest_desc: The Coolant Absorber Ports are one of the many needed things to fully form a nuclear reactor, without these we aren't able to introduce our coolant blocks.
quest.2AF4E2ACA37140A7.title: &lReactor Coolant Absorber Port

quest.2DC19671FC685343.title: &lMachine Fluid Addon
quest.2E15EDE995B7E44C.quest_desc: The &dArcane Catalyst&r is an OP way to enchant our items, allowing us to create Hyper Enchanted Items. It’s quite simple to set up, but there are a few things to keep in mind...
First of all, this machine needs &9souls&r to work! These souls can be collected in two ways:
- Crafting the &3Soul Flower&r. Every time you harvest this flower, it releases some souls, ready to be collected by the Arcane Catalyst.
&4Meddling with the arcane can have serious consequences&r... If mishandled, this machine can explode, destroying itself and causing a fire around it.
However, we can manipulate this effect with &5Enderic Lasers&r!
This machine does not require energy to function, but using Enderic Lasers will stabilize the Arcane Catalyst, preventing it from &cexploding&r.
Once all these conditions are met, we are ready to use this machine.
To enchant our items, simply place a max enchanted book inside the Arcane Catalyst and insert the item you wish to enchant.
With enough souls, the enchantment will be applied to the item. Each level will require more souls until it reaches the max level established by the book itself!

Once the item reaches max level, the enchanted book will disappear, allowing the item to surpass normal limits—for example, reaching &aBoon of Earth VI&r. This system also enables combining normally incompatible enchantments, such as &dMending&r and &3Infinity&r on bows. (Compatibility varies depending on item type and enchantment type, of course.)
&l&4The higher the enchantment level, the more souls it will consume, and it may become unstable&r.
quest.2E15EDE995B7E44C.title: &l&dArcane Catalyst
quest.2E29462D9AD049C8.quest_desc: This energy pipe is the goat!
To me its an excesive amount of energy to handle, but why does it need a single quest you might ask...
And the answer is, I wanted to make the whole questline as symmetrical as possble (which in fact looks amazing and beautiful) but in certain spots it ain't... And that messes me up completely.
But leaving aside all of this, its needed to create the &6&lParticle Accelerator&f!
quest.2E29462D9AD049C8.title: &lThe Mother of Energy Pipes
quest.2EA4BF9A9B390F5F.quest_desc: Operating this nuclear reactor is no joke. Before you even think about fueling it up, you need to ensure proper safety protocols are in place. Reactors can generate immense &cheat&r, and without proper &bcooling&r, things can spiral out of control... &4fast&r.

Make sure your reactor has a stable cooling system, whether there are Heat Pipes, Heat Absorbers or Heat Vents. Monitor its temperature regularly, and never, under any circumstances, overload it beyond its safe limits. A meltdown won’t just ruin your setup—it could take out everything around it like its shown in the image below...
This however will &6BYPASS CLAIMED CHUNKS&r, so make sure you don't run into any type of problems.
Also in case of a &cmeltdown&r... well.. you know what might happen, but let me assure you that you don't need to worry about &aradiation&r in any way!
quest.2EA4BF9A9B390F5F.title: &lSafety Measures

quest.4290772E39EF863B.quest_desc: With the drone port done, it is time to do the unthinkable...

quest.4E19D68D42B1CFD2.quest_desc: Tainted Refinery comes when you explode a Refinery (the block, not item) and an arcane Catalyst with at least 1 soul. Explosion must has visible both blocks.
- It can only do 1 fluid output, but you can change it on the GUI (slot means which output will do)
- It can accept "infinite" (up to 500MFE/t) amount of energy while working to improve speed, but with diminishing returns (Progress += 0.2 * (energy ^ 0.45))

- You can put some blocks around it (on a 16 block radius) to increase efficiency and production. From x1 to x3 in production with sculk based items and x1 to x9 with Arcane blocks. They must have line of sight with the refinery for the buff to apply.
A part from that, efficiency is applied before formula above, making it worth more.
You need to have 4 different types of each category and 16 blocks of each type to get the maximum effect. These effects are only applied when you first make the multiblock.
quest.4EC581DCFFFD7E29.quest_desc: The perfect addon for the Enderic Laser!
With this addon, we are now able to hunt living creatures with ease, such as zombies, skeletons, creepers and wandering traders. Who needs a restriction order when you got a LASER!
quest.4EC581DCFFFD7E29.title: &lMachine Hunter Addon
quest.4F97E9808F237AD0.title: &lJetpacks
quest.503295EA20A20B2E.quest_desc: The Yield addon is in my opinion the best addon for the Fragment Forge, it can be used on the Enderic Laser and Destroyer Block, but the fragment forge being one of the many machines needed to start our ore processing setup it will come in handy!
Why is it so special you ask? Well in short words, it &edoubles&r the amount of &6Byproducts&r given by each process from all of these machines.
quest.503295EA20A20B2E.title: &lMachine Yield Addon
quest.510018A443343E24.quest_desc: Allows to safely store a blakhole inside, while also working as energy storage.
If you have messed up, you can use AE2 Spatial IO to delete the blackhole
quest.5157228531940A0C.quest_desc: Having energy generators we might want to store all of that produced energy...
The &6Large Energy Storage&r is one of the many keys for this, it can hold up to 50MFE inside of it without any problem!
And it becomes way better with the Power Bank Addon.
quest.516B2ED91CD19E2A.quest_desc: The Stabilized Enchanter is a MUCH more powerful block for enchanting our items.
This machine is much easier to understand compared to the Arcane Catalyst, with fewer things to worry about!
By inserting an enchantable item inside this machine, a new GUI will pop up, displaying all available enchantments for that item. To apply an enchantment, we will need both &9Souls&r and &6Energy&r.
Energy can be supplied directly to the machine, so there’s no need to set up another Enderic Laser. However, for souls, we will need to place multiple &dArcane Catalysts&r to feed it.

Within the machine's GUI, we can see how many &9souls&r and &dArcane Catalysts&r are required to enchant our item. With each process, the enchantment will &alevel up&r, allowing us to break the standard enchantment limits entirely!
quest.516B2ED91CD19E2A.title: &l&dStabilized Enchanter
quest.51C668E8BD092586.quest_desc: This being a mod about technology and machines we obviously need to start generating energy for our new machinery.
To start of, Oritech adds plenty of ways to power our machines, from &abasic energy generation&r to &dadvanced energy generation&r.
We can use any type of Energy gen for these machines, but to be honest Oritech's power gen is extremely fun! And more with the &b&lTachyon Absorber&r.
quest.51C668E8BD092586.title: &lEnergy Generators
quest.52249CDB82582B27.quest_desc: This brand new technology mod adds quite a lot of new machines that are pretty good looking... in the form of &5Multiblocks&r
The things that we can create within this mod are wonderful!

So fantastic that it comes with its own set of &bTools&f and&e Armor&r that are extremely op, it also has a way to &dProcess&f all of our ores and &aDupe&f them, multiple ways to generate &cenergy&r and... a [&9&mREDACTED&r]?
As we mentioned, this mod adds a lot of stuff that doesn't fit in this sole quest, so I advice you to gather some &6resources&r before you start with this amazing mod!
quest.52249CDB82582B27.title: &lOriTech
quest.529FB0C5407FB09B.quest_desc: This block is quite useful to prevent any type of meltdowns on our reactor, a failsafe in short words...
By right-clicking it we can change its mode to control the &btempe&crature, &6energy&r stored or if theres not enough &afuel&r inside of it.
You can build your reactor without one of these, but better be safe than sorry!
quest.529FB0C5407FB09B.title: &lReactor Redstone Port
quest.52D353F64E1FE915.quest_desc: And lastly, the best fuel of all
quest.532C4FFB18B50604.quest_desc: We have multiple types of fuels for our reactors, these are essential to make our reactor run and produce energy!
To start of, we will create the &aUranium&r Pellets, which have a duration of &6200&r ticks (100s) each. So knowing this we might need to add more fuel rods on our reactor.
Once we have enough materials, I suggest you to create the &9Plutonium&r Pellets, these are by far the BEST type of fuel we can use on our reactors...
Why? Simply because each pellet has a duration of &620,000&r ticks (1000s)!
quest.532C4FFB18B50604.title: &lReactor Fuels
quest.5448EAA6F02667A4.title: &lExo Boots
quest.5721FCF3AFC744DC.quest_desc: The Bio Generator's base production is 64FE/t.
It is suggested and advised to place some speed and efficiency addons to multiply its generation ratio!
quest.5721FCF3AFC744DC.title: &lBio Generator
quest.57CCE49963B67FE7.quest_desc: It doesn't have much IO, but it has a decent capacity, maybe connect some solar panels to it when you start
quest.5A86360E5888389C.quest_desc: The last tier of components we'll ever use in Oritech...
Is this the meaning of the end?
quest.5A86360E5888389C.title: &l&dHighly Advanced Components
quest.5B35722761CF6D75.quest_desc: The Enderic Laser is quite the machine.
It can break blocks, send energy and evaporate annoying wandering traders with ease!
But how does this work exactly?

Well, first we need to create our &dLaser&r and a &bTarget Designator&r. Next, with our target designator we'll simply need to &eshift+rmb&r the &cun&r/wanted entity or block and then right-click the Laser with it and you're good to go!
With this machine we're able to get Fluxite, simply set this laser on an Amethyst Bud and you're good to go!
It needs energy to work thought, but other than that, its a cool machine!
And its the only thing that can power the &lBedrock Extractor&r.
(&c&nif mishandled it can destroy everything in sight including you&r)
quest.5B35722761CF6D75.title: &lEnderic Laser
quest.5BD1004FF3460C89.quest_subtitle: A mix of Fluxite and Nickel
quest.5BD1004FF3460C89.title: &l&dEnergite Ingot
quest.5D9B11078B6F3AD2.quest_desc: The reactor wall blocks are the start of our Nuclear reactor, these are quite cheap to craft fortunately.
This marvelous multiblock can be of any size!
quest.5D9B11078B6F3AD2.title: &lReactor Wall
quest.5E1F29521570F22A.quest_desc: To begin the construction of our factory, we must create certain components to build our machines.
This at the start might be tedious, but with the &lAssembler&r it will be much easier and much faster... and also cheaper!
quest.5E1F29521570F22A.title: &lBasic Components
quest.5E46635CEBF05866.quest_desc: This addon lets us feed our machines with energy without needing to place it on one of the specified energy input slots.
Simply connect your energy pipe or wireless energy method directly into it!
quest.5E46635CEBF05866.title: &lMachine Acceptor Addon
quest.5EBECF112B07440E.quest_desc: Then it can be turned into Quartz, which is a pretty decent source if you have tons of sand, clay and redstone
quest.5F3A317A8E8976EC.quest_desc: The Heat Vents will allow a proper cooling system within our reactors, there may be cases were these aren't needed... But they do come in handy when the temperature of our reactors are above 1,000.
quest.5F3A317A8E8976EC.title: &lReactor Heat Vent
quest.602C4D5E5998377C.quest_desc: This addon is by far, the best addon we can insert on our energy generators.
Allowing these machines to move more energy without being limited by their base IO transfer rate, while increasing its energy buffer.
quest.602C4D5E5998377C.title: &lMachine Capacitor Addon
quest.60E25D5D198D589F.quest_desc: This addon is the goat and another must!
It lets our machines work in parallel effortlessly at the cost of 50% of the machines efficiency, but with other addons this can be bypassed in no time.
quest.60E25D5D198D589F.title: &lAuxiliary Processing Chamber Addon
quest.639436196C0BE005.quest_desc: The Foundry is the only machine capable of creating the new alloys we'll need.
But thats not the only use for it, we can now create &8Netherite&r, &7Steel&r and &eElectrum&r Ingots in an easier way.
And if we did an Oreproc setup with Oritech's machines, we can mix some metal gems to get more materials out of it.
quest.639436196C0BE005.title: &lFoundry
quest.63B26FEBA47CC5D2.quest_desc: Now you can craft another core, allowing you to put more addons to your machines
quest.63F9CD64F568517E.quest_desc: The &eCybernetic Augmentation Center&r is where science meets the limits of the human body. This facility allows you to install cybernetic &daugmentations&r, permanently enhancing your physical capabilities.
Instead of relying on bulky armor or temporary potions, augments integrate directly into your body, offering benefits such as:
Once installed, these augmentations require no upkeep or fuel!
However, before you can apply an augment, it must first be researched using specialized Research Stations.
A new keybind was also added. By default "G" will open a new GUI to enable or disable these augments with ease!
This station by its own does nothing sadly, so you need to grind your way to create the other 3 Research Stations to apply these new augments!
On the next 3 quests we'll mentioned which augments are unlocked with each station,
quest.63F9CD64F568517E.title: &lCybernetic Augmentation Center
quest.65041E2312518AE3.quest_desc: And to start creating this technological materials we'll need this waffer to create the Advanced Computing Engine for other machines!
quest.65041E2312518AE3.title: &lSilicon Wafer
quest.6575172F5CF3941F.quest_desc: This block is important if we want to extract the energy produced on our reactor, you can place it anywhere over our reactor walls!
quest.6575172F5CF3941F.title: &lReactor Energy Port
quest.6742DC67AEA5AD78.quest_desc: You can easily make the new ingredient, which is used a fair bit
quest.695D2D4B299452DA.quest_desc: The Particle Accelerator Linear Motor is used to increase the particle speed.

When a particle passes through a motor, its speed increases by 1 m/s, consuming RF/FE based on the current particle speed. Higher speeds require more energy, so an efficient motor placement is crucial.
&l&6Tip&f: Place multiple motors along the particle's path to reach higher speeds more efficiently!
quest.695D2D4B299452DA.title: &lParticle Accelerator Linear Motor
quest.69CC686485001A33.title: &lExo Helmet
quest.6B159418F332B368.quest_desc: Now if I were you I would start playing Super Massive Black Hole from Muse while looking at this beauty honestly, don't you even dare to touch it though. I'm not kidding, your grave won't be there
&4&lThere is nothing you can do to stop it... &runless you make a Schröndiger Cage, which later you can delete using AE2 Spatial IO
You better take a look at the Tachyon Absorber quest if you haven't!
quest.6B159418F332B368.quest_subtitle: It's The End of the World
quest.6B159418F332B368.title: &l&0WHAT HAVE YOU DONE
quest.6B959ECB2BE3A6B2.quest_desc: The &dFragment Forge&r is a crucial step to progress to Tier 3!
With this beautiful machine we can get Fluxite in an easier way by processing &l&bPlatinum&r!
Some processes might take a bit longer, but I highly suggest giving this lovely machine some &6Speed Addons&r!
quest.6B959ECB2BE3A6B2.title: &lFragment Forge
quest.6C70C640F57B50E5.quest_desc: This addon makes machine go brrrr~~~
But if machine goes brrrr~~~ it will use moar energy, which is bad!
quest.6C70C640F57B50E5.title: &lMachine Speed Addon
quest.6E27D25E4952662D.quest_desc: Oritech not only offers incredible machines, processes and a logistic system.
It comes with its own Equipment!
Some are extremely op, but require quite a lot of work to create...
quest.6E27D25E4952662D.title: &lOritech's Equipment
quest.6E2E961DA7DAE824.quest_desc: Many of the most important components to grow our factory!
quest.6E2E961DA7DAE824.title: &l&bBetter Components
quest.6E34F79F419BE744.quest_desc: Mineral Slurry comes mainly from Ore processing and Deep Miner
quest.6F12757F2C25D51B.quest_desc: It has 2 uses, as a bee flower and many unholy Intelligence
quest.70B4A9811B52D633.quest_desc: Who needs to chop those trees by hand when ye got this fancy machine to do it!
quest.70B4A9811B52D633.title: &lTree Cutter
quest.72D5EC0F7E7D185C.quest_desc: The Machine Extender will be one of the most used blocks all over your factory!

Why? Simply because this block gives extra space for our addons over our machines, some machines by default can only handle 3 or even 1 addon at the time, but with this our possibilities grow exponentially when it comes to this.
If we want to add even more "addons", we need better &6Machines Cores&r.
quest.72D5EC0F7E7D185C.title: &lBigger Machinery
quest.732DC7BDCF57B2AC.quest_desc: Needs to be built on a machine frame to work.
Another perfect tool to sped up our crops!
Works with vanilla and modded crops.
quest.732DC7BDCF57B2AC.title: &lFertilizer Block
quest.76A5A2E984E8F630.quest_desc: This addon lets us control most of our machines with a redstone pulse.
Allowing us to expand exponentially how we'll manage our factory!
quest.76A5A2E984E8F630.title: &lRedstone Control Unit Addon
quest.777F6A0F95BCF073.quest_desc: Yet a better axe, not electrical sadly, but fancy nancy looking!
By doing shift+lmb we are able to cut down a single tree with ease, same protocol as the chainsaw.
quest.777F6A0F95BCF073.title: &6&lPrometheum Battleaxe
quest.77CF4A40F671E5D8.quest_desc: While it doesn't have lots of uses, the ones that have are important, like allowing you to do multiple recipes at the same time
quest.7916318663251B93.quest_desc: Yes ye' did read the quest title right!
It cannot be a nuclear reactor without any type of danger ya know...
Our Nuclear reactor will need a decent amount of coolant to work and keep the temperature in a decent spot.
quest.7916318663251B93.title: &lCoolants
quest.79E61E1354DF27A1.quest_desc: The &6Centrifuge&r is the second machine we'll need to progress through this mod and we'll need &d2&r in total for the next recipes!
Before we continue I highly advise you take a look at the quest below.
quest.79E61E1354DF27A1.title: &lCentrifuge
quest.79EE5189EBA26CCD.quest_desc: Another tier down, you are quick, aren't you?
quest.7B598DB1E1571973.quest_desc: In Base Oritech we'll need to mix 2 &6Nickel Ingots&r and 2 &bDiamonds&r to make 1 &3Adamant Ingot&r.
But now you'll need 3 &bDiamond Dusts&r and 3 &6Nickel Dusts&r to get 3 &3Adamant Dusts&r!
Either way, you need this Ingot to make the Assembler.
quest.7B598DB1E1571973.title: &l&3Adamant Ingot&r&l
quest.7CC2CA0E5BF2150A.quest_desc: Let me tell you something, throughout Oritech we will be using quite a lot of pipes to transport &bFluids&r, &eItems&r and quite a lot of &cEnergy&r.
This quest is completely optional, but I highly advise you to create at least the energy pipes...
quest.7CC2CA0E5BF2150A.title: &lOritech's Basic Logistics
quest.7D6063FFF0A68794.quest_desc: "So, you want to build a Particle Accelerator?"
Building this multiblock is quite a task...
Not because it’s hard, but because you’re going to question every single life decision you’ve made while setting it up!
Before even thinking of placing a single block, remember this formula:
This defines how far apart the guide blocks can be, allowing for higher speeds without the risk of turning your accelerator into a very expensive explosion generator.
Warning: &4It will be fast, but the word "fast" on a particle accelerator is very, very &alemon&4 dangerous...&f.

Make sure to plan your layout properly, as the bigger the accelerator, the higher the speeds it can achieve. The image below showcases examples of different possible sizes – from a humble circle to an unholy spaghetti mess of high-speed doom.
Now, go forth and build! And remember... if it starts glowing, run.
quest.7D6063FFF0A68794.title: &lThe Particle Accelerator
quest.7DA06F3048FD6038.quest_desc: You can use FTB Quest filters to have better control
quest.7DA06F3048FD6038.title: &lItem Filter
quest.7DF0058AAB23E250.quest_desc: Refining fluids is an important step to your mega factory, there are mainly 2 fluids, Crude Oil and Lava. You have 1 main tank, which has 8 buckets capacity.
quest.7E4327903A20ADEC.quest_desc: You are &lnot&r allowed to use these quests in any public pack without &4&nexplicit permission&r from Catalyst Studios.
If you are seeing this, it means you are in editing mode.
quest.7E4327903A20ADEC.title: &lCatalyst Studios Questline
